project.name: devkit_mini
project._comment: PROJECT SPEC (U1g) - minimal second carrier for the same Zynq SoM, built by the unmodified schgen engine via --project devkit_mini.

silk_labels._comment: Ref-keyed silk FUNCTION labels, authored from this project's own subsystems (debug_boot is sheet 1): J1=Zynq 2x7 2.00mm JTAG header, J2=ARM 10-pin SWD header, SW1=boot DIP (pos1 BOOT0/DFU, pos2/3 BOOTSEL straps, pos4 spare - debug_boot.py position map), SW2=reset button. The SoM DF40 mezzanines are intentionally absent: the 'Zynq SoM' body-silk labels that region.

escape._comment: Measured 2026-07-29 on the live SoM interface + devkit_mini link (full J1/J2/J3 bind, same SoM contract; 4 si_triage-GENUINE pairs on the bound sheets).
